Purpose / topics: What the Glean Blueprint Consultation is, why it exists, its three steps, and the outcomes it produces for customers, partners, and Glean
Measurable module objectives: 1) Define the Blueprint Consultation and its purpose. 2) Name the three steps and the default validation path. 3) Explain why Blueprint replaces open-ended AI experimentation. 4) Distinguish the Sales Blueprint from post-sales SA blueprints.

Module Name: Blueprint in the Glean Sales Process
Purpose / topics: Where Blueprint sits in the Glean opportunity stages, what unlocks it, stage exit criteria, and how it connects to MEDDPICCS and the business case
Measurable module objectives: 1) Map Visioning, DITL and Executive Validation to Stages 2 and 3. 2) State what must be true to enter and exit Blueprint. 3) Apply prescribed remedial actions when exit criteria are not met. 4) Connect Blueprint outputs to MEDDPICCS fields.

Purpose / topics: Who owns each Blueprint step (AE, SE, BVC, partner), partner engagement models, RACI, and how partners accelerate and differentiate through Blueprint
Measurable module objectives: 1) Assign AE, SE, BVC and partner ownership for each Blueprint step. 2) Select a partner engagement model for a deal. 3) Explain how partner-led discovery shortens the Blueprint cycle. 4) Describe when to request BVC support.

Purpose / topics: Entry prerequisites, building the value hypothesis and PBOs, pressure-testing sponsorship, customer pre-work, and session readiness checks
Measurable module objectives: 1) Build a value hypothesis (Why Change, Why Now, Why Glean) tied to strategic priorities. 2) Write PBOs and a 3-5 metric hypothesis per line of business. 3) Run the prerequisites checklist and decide go / reschedule. 4) Send pre-work and agenda that set a consultative tone.

Purpose / topics: Purpose, audience, agenda, facilitation and outputs of the Visioning Session that builds the broad use case list and secures executive alignment
Measurable module objectives: 1) Plan a Visioning agenda with timed segments. 2) Facilitate a consultative, outcome-led conversation. 3) Capture a broad use case list and agree 3-5 priorities. 4) Deliver the recap and next steps within 24 hours.

Purpose / topics: Discovery framework, high-leverage questions, the use case table, impact-vs-effort scoring, technical gotchas, and choosing hero use cases
Measurable module objectives: 1) Use the outcomes > use cases > workflows > data > metrics framework. 2) Complete the use case table with impact and effort rationale. 3) Score and place use cases on the impact-vs-effort 2x2. 4) Identify technical gotchas that change effort or feasibility.

Purpose / topics: Running SE-led Day-in-the-Life interviews, mapping current and future workflows, quantifying cost of inaction, and the optional playback
Measurable module objectives: 1) Prepare DITL interviews for the prioritized use cases. 2) Map current-state steps, systems, time and bottlenecks. 3) Draft the future-state workflow with Glean and the time saved. 4) Decide when a playback session is needed.

Purpose / topics: Turning DITL findings into credible value: value architecture, translation paths to cost, revenue and risk, metrics, evidence tiers, recapture rate, and the Value Calculator
Measurable module objectives: 1) Structure a business case with the four-part value architecture. 2) Translate time savings into cost, revenue or risk impact. 3) Apply the recapture rate and present ranges with labeled evidence. 4) Define metrics with baseline, target, system of record and owner.

Purpose / topics: Preparing, running and following up the Executive Validation readout that confirms sponsorship, success criteria, value and the validation path
Measurable module objectives: 1) Complete the executive validation pre-work checklist. 2) Run the 60-minute readout agenda. 3) Secure sponsorship, success criteria and the validation path decision. 4) Send the recap and update opportunity records within 24 hours.

Purpose / topics: Choosing between a custom demo, Glean Lab, sandbox and pilot/PoC; pilot gating, readiness scoring, and approval
Measurable module objectives: 1) Compare custom demo, Glean Lab, sandbox and pilot on data, prep, duration and cost. 2) Default to the lightest validation that proves value. 3) Apply the pilot entry criteria and readiness scorecard. 4) Frame a sandbox correctly with the champion.

Purpose / topics: The Blueprint deliverable set, recap communications, Mutual Action Plan, success plan, and handoff to delivery, services and customer success
Measurable module objectives: 1) Produce the standard Blueprint deliverables. 2) Build a MAP and success plan from Blueprint outputs. 3) Hand off value commitments so they can be measured after go-live. 4) Attach partner services to the prioritized roadmap.

Purpose / topics: Using Glean agents and prompts to research accounts, draft value hypotheses, generate use case tables and DITL timelines, and check readiness - with human review
Measurable module objectives: 1) Select the right Glean agent or prompt for each Blueprint task. 2) Ground AI outputs in sources and verify them. 3) Apply guardrails so customer stories are not presented as the prospect's outcomes. 4) Build a reusable AI-assisted Blueprint prep flow.

Purpose / topics: Workshop facilitation craft, handling common objections to Blueprint and to value claims, and avoiding the anti-patterns that stall deals
Measurable module objectives: 1) Apply facilitation techniques that keep sessions consultative and on time. 2) Handle objections such as 'just give us a pilot' and 'these are just benchmarks'. 3) Recognize and correct common Blueprint anti-patterns. 4) Recover a stalled Blueprint.

Purpose / topics: End-to-end Blueprint simulation on a fictional company: value hypothesis, Visioning, prioritization, DITL, ROI, executive readout, validation path and MAP
Measurable module objectives: 1) Execute every Blueprint step on a realistic scenario. 2) Produce the full deliverable set. 3) Defend value assumptions and the validation path in a live or recorded readout. 4) Meet the rubric threshold for the Specialist tier.
Roadmap alignment (not equivalency): ACC-102; competency 'AI Strategy & Use Case Discovery' (201)
